source: Accounts payable inbox: invoices for this week's run, Oct 23
author: maya
text:
From: Accounts payable inbox
To: Maya Lopez
Subject: Invoices for this week's payment run

Hi Maya,

Welcome aboard. Three vendor invoices came in this week:

1. Brightline Catering, invoice #4471: $2,400 for the October 30 client lunch, due October 30.
2. Ironclad Security, invoice #IS-2209: $12,600 for the new office badge readers, due November 13.
3. Northgate Office Supply, invoice #NG-818: $3,150 for printer paper and toner, due November 5.

Northgate also emailed on October 22 asking us to send this payment and all future payments to a new bank account.

Thanks,
Accounts payable
